filled_passage:
On Tuesday（星期二）, our class took a model street to the town library（图书馆）. The model had twelve（十二） small houses and a tiny river. Each house could be lifted off so that visitors could see inside. It was a display, rather than a toy for children to play with.

The librarian's daughter（女儿） met us at the door. She cleared a long table while we carried the boxes in. We moved the smallest pieces carefully（仔细地） because their walls were thin. I had made the baker's shop by myself（我自己） at home, and I was nervous about carrying it through the narrow doorway.

We checked the street twice（两次） before opening the doors. My shop was the ninth（第九） building from the left, beside a small wooden（木制的） bridge. Later, visitors asked how we had made the windows. I showed them a spare wall and explained the steps. I felt proud（自豪的） when they stopped to look closely at the details.
